Zaiqa Billing, Zaiqa Waiter, Zaiqa Kitchen and Zaiqa Stock apps, version 2.34.0.

Sales Summary upgrade
• Order type filter (All, Dine In, Take Away, Delivery, Other) on all Summary tabs
• New "By order type" table: bills, sales, average bill, discount, delivery fee, share
• New periods: This week, Last week, This month, Last month
• "All shifts of a day" table with cashier and cash difference
• Day-by-day / week-by-week trend with best and slowest day, and comparison with the previous week, month or period
• Payment split, discounts by cashier, cancelled bills
• Print and CSV follow the selected period and order type
